purpose: RC ladder, 60 sections: ~60-node mid-scale transient test.

oracle.derivation: A 50-section RC ladder driven by a 1 ns-edge PULSE. Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 6.65x its tolerance off it.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b deck + .options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-12 chgtol=1e-20, .tran tmax 60n
